gloss: a destructive weather event, possibly frost
summary: Asaph pairs the loss of Egypt’s sycamores with the loss of its vines to hail. This is the only occurrence of the word.

words.gloss: a destructive weather event, possibly frost

senses.gloss: a destructive weather event, possibly frost
senses.definition: The blow that destroys the sycamores in the account of the plagues. The parallel suggests destructive weather such as frost or hail, but the verse does not identify the agent more precisely.

note: Suggested identifications should be weighed against the parallel line and Exodus 9:25. The noun supplies its own consonantal key.
